attempts.summary: Deployed a Python inventory web app (systemd service, port 8080) on node2 and node3, and configured nginx on node1 as an HTTP load balancer on port 80 round-robining across both backends. Verified firewalld/SELinux config and confirmed round-robin behavior, then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of the inventory services and load-balanced routing.
